message: The other night, we had a little blackout, and I found myself digging out our trusty flashlights and lanterns. It was a lovely reminder of how much fun we can have without all the gadgets—my husband and I ended up playing cards by lantern light, something we haven't done in ages! It was a cozy, low-tech adventure that made me realize sometimes the simplest moments are the most memorable. Have you ever enjoyed a tech-free evening? What activities do you love when the lights go out?
